```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Merged and cleaned data will be uploaded to the Github respository. 

```{r, dataread}
#Read in datasets 1 (Codebook), 4 (FAH Items), 6 ( FAFHEvents), 9(Nutrient), and 12 (Access)
household_codebook <- read.csv("~/Downloads/CSV_data_files/faps_household_puf.csv")
fah_items <- read.csv("~/Downloads/CSV_data_files/faps_fahitem_puf.csv")
fafh_event <- read.csv("~/Downloads/CSV_data_files/faps_fafhevent_puf.csv")
fah_nutrient <- read.csv("~/Downloads/CSV_data_files/faps_fahnutrients.csv")
access <- read.csv("~/Downloads/CSV_data_files/faps_access_puf.csv")

```

Combine fah datasets. 

```{r, datamerge}
library(dplyr)
fah <- fah_items |> 
  left_join(fah_nutrient, by = c("hhnum", "eventid", "itemnum"))
head(fah)
```

combine access and household. 
```{r, datamerge 2}
ac_ho <- household |> 
  left_join(access, by = "hhnum")
head(ac_ho)
```
